hero.subtitle: Drop your PDFs, images and links into isolated spaces, and query them with an AI that runs entirely on your own server - via Ollama, no cloud API, no tracking.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: Isolated spaces
items.desc: Each workspace keeps its documents and conversations to itself - nothing is shared between spaces. Protect one with a password and share it in one click.

items.title: Every format
items.desc: PDF, images, web pages, DOCX, TXT, Markdown: drag and drop them, they're indexed automatically.

items.title: AI vision
items.desc: Scans and photos are read by a multimodal model: the content of your images becomes searchable just like text.

items.title: Local web search
items.desc: Complete answers with the web via a self-hosted search engine, no trackers, no API key.

items.title: Smart request queue
items.desc: AI requests are processed one at a time: even on a small server, the app stays stable with multiple users.

items.title: 100% local and private
items.desc: No data is sent to a third-party cloud API. Everything runs on your own server, with Ollama.

items.title: Create a space
items.desc: Name it, pick a color, add a password if you want to keep it private.

items.title: Drop your documents
items.desc: Drag and drop PDFs, images or web links. The AI reads and indexes them in the background.

items.title: Chat
items.desc: Ask your questions, get answers sourced from your documents (and the web if needed).

opensource.title: Free, open, and local by design
opensource.desc: No account, no subscription, no data collected to train a model. You host it, you control it.

privacy.title: Cookies and personal data
privacy.subtitle: This project is designed to be local and private by default. Here's simply what's stored, and why.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses no tracking or analytics cookies, and no third-party/advertising cookies. No consent banner is needed - there's nothing to consent to.

sections.title: Local storage (localStorage)
sections.body: When you unlock a password-protected workspace, a temporary access token is saved in your browser's local storage (localStorage), solely to avoid re-entering the password on every page. It is never sent to a third party and expires automatically. You can clear it at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.

sections.title: Your documents and conversations
sections.body: The documents you upload, their indexed content, and your conversations are stored only on the server hosting this instance (local database and vector store). Nothing is sent to a third-party cloud AI service: processing (reading, indexing, generating answers) happens locally via Ollama.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.body: If you use the contact form, your name, email and message are kept so we can reply to you. This information is never resold or shared with third parties, and is never used for marketing outreach.

privacy.footnote: This page describes how the software works as provided. The organization hosting this instance remains responsible for the data it collects through this site.
